QuestInfo.name: [Limina] Guard Captain Darknell
QuestInfo.0: You reached the top of the waterfall, and fought off the Black Mage's Elites. Now you finally have a chance to talk to Orchid in #bFinal Horizon#k.
QuestInfo.1: The moment Orchid takes off, the Genesis Crux starts shuddering. It isn't until you defeat Guard Captain Darknell that Orchid tells you Neinheart's waiting to speak to you aboard the White Spear Ship Deck in #bEnd of the World 1-1#k.
QuestInfo.2: The moment Orchid took off, the Genesis Crux started shuddering. It wasn't until you defeated Guard Captain Darknell that Orchid told you Neinheart is waiting to speak to you aboard the White Spear Ship Deck.
